title: Crestline Fleet Account Portfolio Rule: Several Accounts Under One Business
content:
**Rule.** A business may hold more than one Crestline Fleet Account, typically one per division or branch, each with its own roster, terms and invoices. The number of open accounts of the business, counting the new application, may not exceed the number of fleet accounts one business profile may hold under the program applied for.

**Open accounts.** An account counts as open when it is in status applied, active or credit hold. Closed and declined accounts do not count. The count is taken on the business customer's portfolio as it stands on the date of the application, and the application being made is included in it.

**No other ceiling.** This rule sets no per-customer maximum of its own beyond that program figure.

**What is and is not pooled.** How the accounts of one business are combined is governed by the combined credit limit rule and the single-roster rule. Nothing else is pooled: the fleet discount, the purchase order threshold and the late charges on any invoice are always those of the account the invoice is on.

### Counting illustration (hypothetical portfolio)

| Business's existing fleet accounts | Counted toward the limit |
|---|---|
| one active, one on credit hold | 2 |
| one active, one closed | 1 |
| one applied (not yet decided), one declined | 1 |

A business with one active and one applied account that makes a further application under a program allowing 2 accounts per business would count 3 open accounts, which exceeds 2. The same business with one active and one closed account would count 2, which does not exceed 2.

### Basis questions

- *Does a branch account share its parent's discount?* No. Each invoice takes the discount, purchase order threshold and late charges of the account it is on.
- *Is the application itself counted?* Yes; the count includes the new application.
